findings.current: He glared at me, then turned away again.
findings.defect: This adds a glare and turn-away before the next sentence repeats those actions. The source describes his brief anger, then gives one glare and turn-away.
findings.rationale: The source says “순간 울컥한 표정을 지었지만 그뿐이다” (anger showed briefly, but that was all), followed by a single glare and turn-away in line 255.

summary: The chapter is mostly faithful, but one dialogue line changes the exchange, and one action is repeated beyond what the source describes.
